POSTMAN_API_KEY.description: The shared Postman account's API key (create one at https://go.postman.co/settings/me/api-keys). The proxy serves every user through this one account.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Needed only when REQUIRE_AUTH is "false": the password that unlocks the admin panel via POST /auth/admin-login. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 24`.

DB.description: D1 database storing users, tokens, settings, uid maps and the audit log. Created automatically on first deploy; the Worker migrates its schema itself on the first request.
